The '''Airam Sector Championships''' was a [[Shockball/Legends|shockball]] competition that [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] in the [[Airam sector/Legends|Airam sector]] competed in. In [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], the talented shockball player [[Kob Mondray]] led the corporate team of his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Ochotl]] to victory in the competition.
